newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania state-owned bank to be sold in September.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania state-owned bank to be sold in September.

text.p: Tanzania's state-owned National Bank of Commerce (NBC) will be privatised on September 30 under bills before parliament, finance ministry officials said on Tuesday.
The bills provide for the NBC, Tanzania's biggest state-run commercial bank, to be split into a National Bank of Commerce Limited and a National Microfinance Bank to start operations on October 1.
Tanzania's national assembly was expected to pass laws by next week marking the formal start of the bank's controversial restructuring programme.
The World Bank is withholding payment of a $125 million Structural Adjustment Credit (SAC) pending legal amendments to the NBC Act and action on splitting the bank's assets.
Progress on the bank's privatisation has been controversial since former president Julius Nyerere said he was concerned its break-up would restrict credit facilities to Tanzania's farmers.
